hypotheses.H1: At equal redispatch effort, adding the dense 0-50 ms evaluation (DQ1) increases the observed minimum Pmax margin at b8 S3 relative to the uniform band E by >= 0.0025 pu (registered prediction: +0.0109 pu on the predicted margin, 0.0068 vs -0.0041).
hypotheses.H2: At equal redispatch effort, M3+OS (D) keeps a larger observed margin than a uniform band tuned to its effort (EQ1) at b8 S3 by >= 0.0025 pu (registered: 0.0133 vs 0.0043).
hypotheses.H3: At b21 S3 the ordering D > EQ1 > DQ1 > E is predicted (0.0037, -0.0013, -0.0028, -0.0098); only differences >= 0.0025 pu are claimed as confirmed.
hypotheses.H4: Observed minus predicted margin stays within [0, +0.0025] pu as in the 17 earlier runs (conservative predictor).

decision_rule: A difference is CONFIRMED if the observed difference has the predicted sign and magnitude >= 0.0025 pu (the largest registered prediction error of the ablation); |difference| < 0.0025 pu is reported as NOT DISTINGUISHABLE; opposite sign REFUTES. All four cells are reported, none dropped.
attribution_rule: Benefit attributed to preventive headroom if the predicted pre-event headroom (pmax - P_pre) explains the observed margin difference to within 0.0025 pu; otherwise to a change in the excursion (observed peak minus the pre-event headroom is compared between designs).
